structurePatterns: centered vertical column: optional visual, title, supporting text, actions
visual is an optional Lucide icon in a soft tinted circle (64px) or small illustration
at most one visually primary action; an optional secondary text action
recoverable-error uses danger accent for the visual and a retry action
usageHints: copy explains the state and the next useful action
illustration is optional; do not let it dominate the task
no-results is contextual to the query, not a global product empty state
